candidates.statement: Payment service shows elevated latency (p95 1600ms) with payment.authorize spans at 1350ms returning ERROR and 9 downstream_deadline_exceeded 504 warnings, while order, gateway and inventory remain healthy (p95 70ms, low error rate). This localizes the checkout degradation to payment-side downstream latency.

report.explanation: Only payment shows anomalous latency and errors (p95 1600ms, authorize ERROR, 504 deadline warnings); gateway, order and inventory are healthy. Order deploy record alone cannot establish causation. Root cause is bounded to payment-side downstream latency; the specific slow dependency is not yet identified.
